tests.note: The EUT is powered by batteries, and does not apply to this clause.

tests.detector: Peak for pre-scan (120 kHz resolution bandwidth)
procedure_notes: Radiated emission test conducted in a semi-anechoic chamber.
Tabletop EUT placed on a non-metallic table 0.8m above ground reference plane; floor-standing EUT placed on horizontal ground reference plane separated by 0.1m insulation.
Pre-scan performed in spectrum mode with peak detector before final measurements.
EUT rotated 360° at each frequency; antenna raised and lowered from 1 to 4 meters; measurements performed for both horizontal and vertical antenna polarization.
Level = Read Level + Antenna Factor + Cable Loss – Preamp Factor

semantic_fragments.content: Performance Criteria Description in IEC 60601-1-2: Examples of test failures include: malfunction; non-operation when operation is required; unwanted operation when no operation is required; deviation from normal operation that poses an unacceptable RISK to the PATIENT or OPERATOR; component failures; change in programmable parameters; reset to factory defaults (MANUFACTURER's presets); change of operating mode; a FALSE POSITIVE ALARM CONDITION; a FALSE NEGATIVE ALARM CONDITION (failure to alarm); cessation or interruption of any intended operation, even if accompanied by an ALARM signal; initiation of any unintended operation, including unintended or uncontrolled motion, even if accompanied by an ALARM signal; error of a displayed numerical value sufficiently large to affect diagnosis or treatment; noise on a waveform in which the noise would interfere with diagnosis, treatment or monitoring; artefact or distortion in an image in which the artefact would interfere with diagnosis, treatment or monitoring; failure of automatic diagnosis or treatment ME EQUIPMENT or ME SYSTEM to diagnose or treat, even if accompanied by an ALARM signal.

Examples of performance during and after the applied testing stimulus required to pass the test: for a mammography system, the compression full release and associated command remains fully operational; for ULTRASOUND DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT, the probe heating, dissipative power and temperature shall remain within specifications; safety-related functions perform as intended; false operation of alarms, 'fail safe' modes and similar functions do not occur. NOTE: This might require performing the test twice – once to ensure the functions occur as expected and again to ensure they do not occur falsely.
